scenario_name: 2 omitted dimensions; intended use: Spring section (Sezione primavera)
initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface_area filter. The capacity of 14 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per person was provided. The future spring-section use is not used to infer the current typology.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 180 (gross floor area) and a 3.0 km haversine radius around the Location Agent's coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892), using canonical latitude/longitude columns. The tipologia_bene_immobile requirement (Attività scolastiche) was ignored because that column is not in the filterable_columns allowlist; the closest allowed equivalent is property_type. Capacity (14 people) was not an extracted requirement, so no predicate was added. Results are ordered by distance to the coordinates.
